title: An Investigation of the (In)effectiveness of Counterfactually Augmented Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on specific challenge sets (e.g., Stress Tests and MNLI challenge examples) where non-contradiction examples contain negation words in the hypothesis, testing if the model over-relies on negation words to predict contradiction.

Evaluating models on the non-entailment subset of the HANS challenge set to see if the model incorrectly predicts entailment solely based on high lexical overlap (e.g., >90% of words in the hypothesis present in the premise).
